subject: planner: add auto hash64 and equals generator for logical operators. (#57004)
summary: Introduces a reflection-based code generator to auto-generate LogicalJoin.Hash64 based on struct tags, replaces the hand-written Hash64 with a generated equivalent, and adjusts planner generator layout (plan_clone generator moved under plan_cache) plus Bazel/nogo config updates. No Blocker/High issues found in the planner runtime behavior touched by this commit.
